VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Definition changed by the deep pass of 2026-09-11 (V01, triage 3/3): only ids the answer gives as cards are fetched -- a species id or a backtest run_id is not -- and an answer over 24 h old is not a current recommendation. The original failure this row was opened on is documented in report #91. PRE-0099 passes it: both cards named in NEX-0019 resolve.
